servinfo.title: Steering Switch (Audio Control Switch and Hands-Free Switch) Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: Remove steering wheel referring to Steering Wheel Removal and Installation .
Remove screws, center garnish (6) and steering wheel cover (2).
Disconnect connector (1) and then remove hands-free switch (3) from steering wheel.
Remove audio control switch (4) and cruise control switch (5) (if equipped) from steering wheel.
